flashcard_questions.q: A musical pattern that is repeated at a higher or lower pitch.
A short musical pattern that is repeated continuously throughout a section or piece.
When a musical idea is heard in one part and then copied closely by another part shortly after.
These devices appear across _____ Classical, and Romantic music — the whole span of the Western Classical Tradition (1650–1910) that AoS1 covers

flashcard_questions.a: A sustained or continuously repeated note, usually in the bass, over which other parts move freely.
